text:
sanjay: heads up — deploy-bot paused release/2026-03-20 (canary) due to 5xx spike in eu-west-1. seeing redis timeouts cascading into app. https://grafana.internal/red/xyz

deploy-bot: Deploybot: Release hold applied to release/2026-03-20 by system. Reason: REGION=eu-west-1 5xx spike. Actions: pin release, cancel remaining canaries, notify ops. To resume: /deploy resume <release> once cleared.

jess: ok. can we pin the currently running version? i don't want the partial canary to roll forward. @matt @ops-lead

matt: +1 pin. also suggest reschedule main rollout to 2026-03-21 04:00 UTC and run a small smoke in us-east first. ops-lead?

ops-lead: oncall says incident still open in eu. prefer rollback of canary to stable revision if we can do it safely, otherwise pin + reschedule window. rollback risk = config drift. what's easier operationally?

oncall: still seeing increased 5xx on reads in eu-west-1, mitigation in progress (scale + redis restart). ETA ~45m. don't recommend pushing anything into eu until resolved. pin + reschedule is safest.

jess: plan then:
1) pin release/2026-03-20 at revision r20260320-1
2) cancel remaining canaries
3) reschedule rollout to 2026-03-21 04:00 UTC
4) update release notes and customer comms

matt: filing now. calendar event id: cal_GHk23. also adding a note: revert plan ready if needed. tagging @oncall to post update when incident cleared.

deploy-bot: Action executed: release pinned to r20260320-1, canaries canceled. Next steps: run preflight at reschedule time; resume command required: /deploy resume release/2026-03-20.

jess: thanks. everyone ack with :thumbsup: when you see this.

matt: :thumbsup:

ops-lead: :thumbsup:

oncall: :thumbsup:
